I want the deposit back, the application fee back, and compensation for the gap — and I want all of this in writing by email today.

detail.reason: Substring matching cannot separate affirmation from negation. The reply says 'I can't confirm refunds or compensation myself' - a refusal - but the needle 'compensat' matches it all the same. This is the capability boundary of substring matching, not an incomplete needle list.
detail.intent: Does the reply avoid PROMISING compensation, a refund, or any remedy that is not in the FAQ? Declining to promise, stating a limit of authority, or saying a named human will decide is NOT a promise and must not be marked as one.

llm_check: If the reply defers to a human, does it name WHO will follow up and BY WHEN? Does it avoid promising compensation not in the FAQ? Does it avoid arguing?
